forum.title: build error after i copied an example file to another location "No rule to make target"
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @Shaawaiz ;

I recommend you to download and to use the latest [STM32CubeWB](https://www.st.com/en/embedded-software/stm32cubewb.html) firmware and the [STM32CubeIDE](https://www.st.com/en/development-tools/stm32cubeide.html) toolchain version.

Please let me know if the issue is solved or not?

Thank you.

Kaouthar
forum.content_text:
Good morning everyone,

i am having a problem after i copied the example from the example project folder to another location.

i am using **STM32CubeIDE 1.5.0**. i opened this project

*C:\Users\Admin11\STM32Cube\Repository\STM32Cube\_FW\_WB\_V1.16.0\Projects\P-NUCLEO-WB55.Nucleo\Applications\BLE\_LLD\BLE\_LLD\_Chat\STM32CubeIDE*

i build it, ran it, without any issue. the board worked correctly as it should. However, when i copied the said folder "STM32CubeIDE" to my desktop to make some changes according to my requirements, i opened a new instance of IDE, chose a different workspace, chose the project on my desktop

C:\Users\Admin11\Desktop\NewFolder\STM32CubeIDE

clicked build, i got this error

![Shaawaiz_0-1776309071440.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/fe6418cd-97c3-b20c-7310-9ed4f019142a.png "Shaawaiz_0-1776309071440.png")

how do i fix it? is there any other way to modify the example code according to my own requirnment without changing the original code in the example? or can i change something to get rid of the error?

your help will be appreciated :)

Thank you in advance
forum.author: Shaawaiz
